name: Cahors

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Malbec sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.

notes: Cahors is a red only, made mostly from Malbec, dark and deep in color and able to age a long time.
The wines are dark purple, with aromas of damson, tobacco and raisin.

blurb.text: A South West France appellation for red wine only, built on Malbec, known locally as Cot or Auxerrois. Malbec must make up at least 70% of the blend, with Merlot and Tannat allowed in smaller roles.
